lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the branchial region. These clusters are organized into three primary horizontal tiers, with the most distinct centroids forming a staggered grid across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, creating a lattice-like pattern that is most defined in the region between the gill slits and the pectoral fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are present on the upper third of the visible flank, showing a sharp pixel intensity gradient with lighter values on the upper edge and darker, shadowed values on the lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple slender, dark, fish-like silhouettes (likely remoras) positioned near the ventral midline and the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
